source_selection.window_phase_rule: Find first and last telemetry sample with a WINDOW_ phase. In chronological camera-archive frames contained in that interval, take floor((2*i+1)*N/12) for i=0..5, before computing any fit.
source_selection.previous_capture_rule: Use exact rejection NPZ prior for native. For each WINDOW image use the latest strictly earlier native vehicle_visual_odometry pose_frame=1 entry, recover its acquisition stamp on the 4ms Gazebo grid only when the EKF timestamp_sample is within 1ms, and require capture delta in (0,120ms]. Exclude unavailable priors before fitting. Use PX4 attitude brackets without extrapolation. Truth is loaded only after registration and gating.
source_selection.synthetic_alias_prior_rule: Use policy-06 previous sensor EV position and tilt, rotated to the synthetic case's commanded 69-degree heading. Use the native source's recorded capture interval as the declared synthetic test interval. The NPZ synthetic reference body position is used only for scoring.

estimator.archive_scope: 5Hz selected JPEG and millimetre PNG image records with native 20Hz sensor-EV priors. This tests single capture survey admission. Native prior RGBD reference frames are unavailable for full fallback replay.
estimator.native_scope: Exact float32 rejected frame, RGB, recorded prior transform and capture clock, recorded ToF and tilt. Prior RGBD frame unavailable.
estimator.alias_scope: Existing synthetic CAD view and existing seeded Gaussian depth realization. No independent physical hardware measurement.

stereo_diagnostic.horizontal_focal_length_px: Use recorded fx in the same simulated image grid.
stereo_diagnostic.projection: Rectified left reference. d=fx*B/Z. Pixel u projects to round(u-d) in the right view. For eligible valid finite source rays keep the maximum disparity in each right-view bin. A ray outside the right image is unavailable. An in-image ray with projected disparity more than 0.5px below the maximum at its bin is occluded.
stereo_diagnostic.far_mismatch_rule: For finite foreground centers only, find the nearest same-row finite pixel within 8px having optical-Z at least 0.10m farther. Break ties in favor of the lower column index. Replace the center with that measured farther value. This is an intentionally adverse finite edge-correspondence stress, not a driver model. It never replaces an invalid return.

metrics.register_depth_accepted: Raw production survey registration result, including overlap, residual, observability and covariance gates.
metrics.survey_runtime_gates_accepted: Passes current timing, motion and absolute survey uncertainty checks. No MAVLink is sent. A failed survey is reported separately from a full estimator fault because preceding native RGBD fallbacks are unavailable.
metrics.score_position_error: 3D Euclidean body position error, independently interpolated observation truth at the actual image stamp. Report horizontal error separately.
metrics.policy_negative_control: Separate actor-only check for erroneous NaN-hole to +Inf conversion. Run once per input using the dilated mask. Never send it to estimator or policy service.
metrics.report: All attempts, exclusions, gates, masks, before/after valid counts and actually modified pixel counts, accepted pose error, reject reason, available weak Hessian direction, policy admission and changed near-to-far bins, observed versus false-safe categories, source SHA256, dependencies and configuration.

scope_limits: This is a deterministic perturbation of recorded Gazebo depth. It does not emulate the full OAK-D S2 stereo matcher, calibration, texture, illumination or temporal filtering.
The baseline is an explicit diagnostic assumption. Projected visibility and rounded disparity are sensitivity cases on the simulator's camera grid.
A sample set with zero counterexamples does not establish a deployment error bound or physical safety.
